title: Prompt (prompt/*.json)
description: One prompt per JSON file under prompt/. Specified-prompt image generation; not cartesian LoRA training rows.

lora.description: LoRA applied to this spec. One per prompt.

id.description: Identifier of the LoRA on the generation server. Not a path on the CLI host.

strength_model.description: Model strength when applying the LoRA. When omitted, 1 is used.

strength_clip.description: Text-encoder strength when applying the LoRA. When omitted, 1 is used.

pose.description: Optional pose on the generation server. Omit pose entirely when unused.

id.description: Identifier of the pose on the generation server. Not a path on the CLI host.

positive.description: Positive prompt tags, joined for generation. Trigger words belong here. Empty emits no positive tags.

negative.description: Negative prompt tags, joined for generation. Empty emits no negative tags.
